description: Associate an organization-owned, non-archived LMS course with one job. stage selects what the link serves: TRAINING (default, draft or published) is the post-hire Training tab — linking publishes nothing and assigns nobody, assignment stays a separate Project To-do step that requires an exact PUBLISHED course version. SCREENING is the application stage: from then on every NEW proposal on the job gets a course binding automatically (applicants take the course and quiz before hire); it requires a PUBLISHED current version at link time, at most one ACTIVE screening link per job, and does not enroll existing proposals (use opentrain_lms_screening_assign). screeningMaxAttempts (SCREENING only, default 1) caps quiz attempts per applicant. Duplicate links for the same pair converge idempotently; stage and ceiling are part of the receipt payload, so a retry that changes them under the same key is a 409. Requires confirmLink=true (explicit acknowledgement of a live shared-state change) and an idempotency key. Requires lms:write.

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key: 8-128 characters of letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash, or colon. Same key + same payload replays the stored receipt; same key + changed payload is a 409.

name: opentrain_lms_link_job_course
